description: Boost++ adds individual boost controls to every building and transport in your factory. Adjust machines, offices, ore sorters, waste plants, belts and pipes from a central manager. Rename buildings, attach searchable comments, jump the camera to any entry, copy boost between buildings, apply mass boosts, and more.
description_short: Fine-tune production speed for every machine, belt and pipe individually — with a manager for sorting, renaming, comments, mass-boost, copy-boost, and more
